_note: All thresholds are provisional (verified=false) until the team matches them against the references. A threshold without a reference or measurement method means insufficient data. allowed_media lists the media each profile covers (also provisional).

rule3_settings._note: Provisional settings for rule 3, adjust per greenhouse.

open_field.ref: UF/IFAS CV296 Table 1/6 (pH). CV123 Ch.7 has no soil pH/EC limits

ec.source: FAO Irrigation and Drainage Paper 29 Rev.1 (1985), ECe threshold 2.5 dS/m for tomato and cucumber (saturated paste). Threshold = where yield loss starts, not an unsuitable limit.
ec.note: Applies to mineral soil measured as saturated-paste ECe only. Soilless media / pour-through / solution EC have no limit yet: result is insufficient until a source (e.g. CV265) is added.
